### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of the mcmicro results (registration/, segmentation/, quantification/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/, and backsub/, illumination_correction/, tma_dearray/ when those steps ran). |
| `SAMPLESHEET_FILE` | — | The cycle samplesheet the run was launched with (--input_cycle: sample, cycle_number, image_tiles). Auto-detected from {DATA_ROOT}/input/ when omitted. |
| `SEGMENTER` | — | Segmentation module whose mask and MCQUANT cells the Image and Markers tabs show: mesmer, cellpose or mccellpose (the pipeline default). |
| `COMPARE_SEGMENTER` | — | Second segmentation module, drawn in the Segmentation QC tab's viewer. Optional; its collections are skipped when the run did not use it. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample id in METADATA_ID_COL, one column per factor. GROUP_COL becomes the condition column of the samples hub; the other factors are carried as extra columns. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table id column. Auto-detected as the first column. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design table factor the run compares, carried as the condition column. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### Conditional routes

Rows are data collections; columns are the variables you set or `params.json` flags auto-detected from the run. Each filled cell is the effect of **setting** that variable; an **empty cell** means that variable leaves the collection unchanged. (18 collections are unaffected by any variable — present on every run.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`backsub/markers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/backsub/markers.py) | Backsub's adjusted marker sheet, one row per channel of the corrected image. | `sample`, `channel_number`, `cycle_number`, `marker_name`, `exposure`, `background`, `background_subtracted` |
| [`coreograph/core_centroids.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/coreograph/core_centroids.py) | Coreograph's tissue-microarray core centroids, one row per detected core. | `sample`, `core`, `y_centroid`, `x_centroid` |
| [`mcquant/cells.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/cells.py) | Tidy MCQUANT's single-cell feature tables into one row per segmented cell. | `sample`, `segmenter`, `cell_id`, `cell_uid`, `x_centroid`, `y_centroid`, `area`, `major_axis_length`, `minor_axis_length`, `eccentricity`, `solidity`, `extent`, `orientation`, `dominant_marker`, `pc_1`, `pc_2` |
| [`mcquant/marker_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/marker_long.py) | MCQUANT marker intensities melted to one row per (cell, marker). | `sample`, `segmenter`, `cell_id`, `cell_uid`, `marker`, `marker_type`, `intensity`, `log_intensity` |
| [`mcquant/marker_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/marker_matrix.py) | Marker by sample matrix of median log1p intensity, for a heatmap. | `marker`, `marker_type` |
| [`mcquant/sample_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mcquant/sample_summary.py) | One row per sample and segmenter: how many cells, and how they are shaped. | `summary_id`, `sample`, `segmenter`, `n_cells`, `median_area`, `median_major_axis_length`, `median_minor_axis_length`, `median_eccentricity`, `median_solidity`, `median_extent`, `n_markers` |
| [`nf-core/mcmicro/acquisition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mcmicro/recipes/acquisition.py) | Acquisition parameters of every sample and cycle, from the pipeline's input checks. | `sample`, `cycle`, `pixel_size`, `pixel_size_unit`, `channel_count`, `pixel_datatype`, `tile_count`, `tile_size_x`, `tile_size_y`, `n_checks_failed`, `n_checks_warned` |
| [`nf-core/mcmicro/cell_markers.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mcmicro/recipes/cell_markers.py) | Per-cell marker matrix of the Image tab's segmenter, keyed for a group comparison. | `cell_uid`, `sample`, `condition`, `dominant_marker` |
| [`nf-core/mcmicro/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/mcmicro/recipes/samples.py) | One row per sample of an nf-core/mcmicro run: the hub every tab filters on. | `sample`, `n_cycles`, `condition` |
